title: Channel browse, MOVE, QUERY and DELETE CHANNEL: STARTBROWSE / GETNEXT / ENDBROWSE CONTAINER, MOVE CONTAINER across channels, QUERY CHANNEL's count, DELETE CHANNEL taking its containers, CHANNELERR / CONTAINERERR / TOKENERR / END

scenarios.summary: CABROW puts three containers in a new channel, counts them (QUERY CHANNEL), browses them (three GETNEXTs, END, ENDBROWSE, then a stale token), MOVEs one to a new channel, and DELETEs the channel: the count, the moved container and the re-created channel are checked after each step
DELETE CHANNEL of a channel that does not exist, with neither RESP nor HANDLE CONDITION: the task abends AEZV
